author: Mark Thompson
title: Wolf Alice, Nation of Language & Gorillaz: La Prima Serata
text:
wolf Alice, Nation of Language Join Gorillaz for Italy’s “La Prima Estate” Festival
Tickets for the highly anticipated second weekend of the “La Prima Estate” festival are now available, with organizers announcing the addition of British indie-rock darlings Wolf Alice and rising synth-pop sensation Nation of Language to a lineup already headlined by Gorillaz. The June 27th concert,culminating with a performance by Gorillaz,is shaping up to be a highlight of the Italian summer festival season. This announcement builds on an already extraordinary roster that includes Jack White, Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds, Twenty One Pilots, Wet Leg, Sleaford Mods, and Emiliana Torrini, solidifying “La Prima Estate” as a key destination for international music fans.
Wolf Alice: Pioneering british Pop-Rock
Described as a symbol of the renewal of British pop-rock, Wolf Alice has consistently captivated audiences and critics as their emergence with “My Love Is Cool.” The band’s trajectory includes a mercury Prize nomination for “Visions of a Life” and the UK number-one success of “blue Weekend,” which also earned them the coveted Best Group award at the Brit Awards.
Their latest album, “The Clearing,” released on August 29, 2025, represents a new artistic phase for the group. Recorded in Los Angeles with Greg Kurstin, the album is characterized by its ambitious scope and inspiration drawn from 1970s melodies. Following years of sold-out tours and appearances at major global festivals, Wolf Alice promises a highly anticipated live show at “La Prima Estate.”
Nation of Language: Alt-Pop Innovators
Nation of Language has quickly become one of the most original projects in the contemporary synthpop landscape.The band has garnered international attention for its unique ability to blend electronic sensibilities with deeply human lyricism. Their breakthrough came with “Strange Disciple” (2023),named Album of the Year by rough Trade,establishing them as a leading voice in alt-pop.
Their newest work, “Dance Called Memory,” produced by Nick Millhiser (known for his work with LCD Soundsystem and Holy ghost!), expands their sonic palette and explores themes of loss, friendship, and the search for authentic connection.
Festival Details and Ticketing
“La Prima Estate” will run from June 19th to 21st and June 26th to 28th. The full festival calendar includes:
- Friday, June 19th: Jack White + artists to be announced
- Saturday, June 20th: Artists to be announced
- Sunday, June 21st: Artists to be announced
- Friday, June 26th: Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds – Sleaford Mods – Emiliana Torrini + artist to be announced
- Saturday, June 27th: Gorillaz – Wolf Alice – Nation of Language + artist to be announced
- Sunday, June 28th: Twenty one Pilots – Wet Leg + artists to be announced
The festival has previously hosted a diverse range of acclaimed artists, including Paolo Nutini, Bon Iver, Jamiroquai, Lana Del Rey, St. Vincent,Air,Jane’s Addiction,Michael Kiwanuka,and The National. Tickets for individual evenings and 3-day passes for the second weekend are available for purchase at ticketone.it. The Municipality of Camaiore and the Tuscany region serve as institutional partners for the festival, with Virgin Radio as the official radio partner.
